findings.what: The Go back click handler uses `if (ours && history.length > 1)`. The spec decision says the script goes back when document.referrer is same-origin, and explicitly rejects `history.length > 1`. The extra guard is a departure from the decision, so a same-origin referrer with history.length of 1 goes home instead of back.

The States table rows are only partly asserted. The `/`-with-no-items row (existing 'says so when the table is empty') checks only the message, not that the filter links show with All current or that the list is hidden. No test for rows 1–4 asserts the 'Go back' link is hidden (no 'Go back' text or script on 200 pages).
findings.fix: Add assertions: on the empty `/`, the nav is present with All current and there is no `<ul>`; on 200 pages (all four success rows), the HTML does not contain 'Go back'.

findings.what: The `/?category=...` query selects `? AS category` bound to the name. This works but is an unusual detour compared with joining categories.
findings.fix: Optional: reuse the join query with a WHERE clause.
